atomicity: one all-or-nothing transaction for all 74 targets; never per-row commits
lock_strategy: pg_advisory_xact_lock derived deterministically from package_id, then SELECT FOR UPDATE in canonical order
application_steps: abort before mutation on any blocker
insert matching audits with predicate-bearing conflict target and equality verification
rollback_steps: verify matching application events and applied statuses

guarded_sql_templates.preflight: SELECT ... FROM content_staging.reading_segments WHERE (run_id, book_id, segment_key) IN (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1)) ORDER BY run_id, book_id, segment_order, segment_key FOR UPDATE
guarded_sql_templates.application: UPDATE content_staging.reading_segments SET approval_status = $1 WHERE run_id = $2 AND book_id = $3 AND segment_key = $4 AND approval_status = $5
guarded_sql_templates.audit: INSERT INTO content_staging.migration_audit_events (...) VALUES (...) ON CONFLICT (event_key) WHERE package_id = 'reading-segment-reviewed-boundary-execution' AND event_version = 1 AND decision_id IS NOT NULL AND book_id IS NOT NULL AND segment_key IS NOT NULL AND event_key IS NOT NULL AND event_action IN ('status-advanced','status-rollback') DO NOTHING
guarded_sql_templates.postflight: SELECT ...; -- compare all immutable projections, status, audit payload and exact counts before COMMIT
guarded_sql_templates.rollback: UPDATE content_staging.reading_segments SET approval_status = $1 WHERE run_id = $2 AND book_id = $3 AND segment_key = $4 AND approval_status = $5
